summary: Completed comprehensive multi-tenant data isolation security testing for MedicAI. All 19 tests passed. Data isolation between clinics is working correctly - doctors can only see their own clinic's data and get 404 when trying to access other clinics' resources.

minor.issue: PatientResponse model doesn't include clinic_id field in response
minor.impact: Minor - filtering works correctly, just not visible in response

Super admin can see all appointments across all clinics

Doctor sees filtered appointments (only their clinic's appointments)

WhatsApp webhook accepts Ref:CODE format
WhatsApp webhook accepts #CODE format (without parentheses)

critical_code_review_comments: Data isolation is properly implemented using clinic_id filtering in all database queries
Super admin access is correctly enforced with require_super_admin dependency
Cross-clinic access returns 404 (not 403) which is correct security practice - doesn't reveal resource existence
seed_data_creation: Multiple test doctor accounts created during testing for isolation verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-tenant data isolation is fully working. All endpoints filter by clinic_id for non-super-admin users. WhatsApp webhook accepts multiple code formats: (#CODE), Ref:CODE, #CODE. Test doctors were created for both DRCASTELLA and DEMO01 clinics to verify cross-clinic access prevention.
